lastResponse.text: Next step: use the Oregon Food Bank Food Pantry and Meal Locator and search “Eugene” (or a downtown Eugene ZIP) to find the closest pantry or meal site now. If you need a backup contact, Clackamas Service Center can help with food and to-go meals, and they don’t require documents. Call 5-0-3, 7-7-1, 7-9-1-4. That’South 5-0-3, 7-7-1, 7-9-1-4.
